summary: Up from w9 (7.8). The headrest now reads as the ZIM/ANA one. It has short, domed, puffy ears with a clean rounded bottom and a crease over the shortened bolsters. There is no more saw-tooth intersection. The navy flap sits between the ears and the rolled-edge tabs are gone. From behind, the rim above the bezel is about 0.18 of the bezel height (35-45 px over 225 px in q13b), against 0.16-0.19 in py_37304 / san_26. The roller, the console side panel and the deeper bucket are in. Back-cloth contrast is now close to the photo: p10/p50 0.66-0.74 against 0.66 in py_37301, and the gradient is 75-90 % of the photo's. It is not 8.5 yet, because of the most eye-catching remaining detail, the stowed gooseneck heads. The w9 fix overshot. Two fat chrome heads (seat pairs centred only 4.3 cm apart) now tilt 32 deg forward and splay 12 deg, so in q13 and q14 they cross like chopsticks right under the headrest. In every stowed photo (py_37301, 37302, 37303, san_26) the heads hang near-vertical, clearly apart, roughly halfway down the back. Smaller items: the flap still reads taller than in the official high-camera shots, the bottom net of the literature bucket is a flat slab, and the fabric is about 35 % less saturated than the official photos.
lighting_note: Rated during the lighting mid-iteration (from_integration.md note, 56bb5c7). I judged levels against neighbours and colours from the studio renders. q14 fabric L50 is 105 against 123 in w9, the known lighting darkening, not penalised.

issues.issue: The stowed gooseneck heads read as a crossed pair of chrome chopsticks right under the headrest. Adjacent seats' heads sit 4.3 cm apart centre to centre (x = +-0.255 per seat with a 0.5525 m seat spacing, so a 4 mm gap for 38 mm heads). The 32 deg forward tilt plus the 12 deg splay then makes them overlap and converge from the q14 / q13 viewpoints. They also hang too high: centre at y 0.635 on the back, about 0.30-0.45 of the back height from the top (q14), against 0.46-0.56 in py_37301. From behind (q13b) they sit at 0.25-0.55 of the bezel height, against about 0.8 in san_26. In every stowed photo (py_37301, 37302, 37303, san_26) each head hangs near-vertical (0-20 deg), about 1.5 head diameters clear of its neighbour, on a longer hose. py_37305 is a posed, pulled-out shot, not the stowed state, so w9a's splay request was wrong.
issues.evidence: q14 crop 380-520 x 160-300 shows the heads overlapping in a V. py_37301 crop 420-560 x 60-220 shows two parallel vertical heads with a clear gap, at mid-back. q13 shows diagonal chrome sticks on every pair. san_26 shows the head at the lower bezel.
issues.fix: src/09b_py.js gooseneck: hd = M4.mul(BH, M4.trs(sd*0.232, 0.53, -0.13, 0, 12*DEG, 0)) (x 0.255 -> 0.232 gives about 9 cm between neighbours' centres, about 1.4 diameters of gap; y 0.635 -> 0.53; tilt 32 -> 12 deg; splay 12 -> 0). Lengthen the hose to suit: C = [[0.24, 0.84, zr(0.84)-0.065], [0.268, 0.78, -0.04], [0.255, 0.64, -0.11], [0.236, 0.59, -0.128]]. Check the clearance against the bolster at y 0.53 (the head must stay just outside the back flank or in the shell gap). If it collides, keep x 0.245 and accept about a 5 cm gap.
